name: sass-scss-completion
description: Completes Sass function and mixin parameters in SCSS, Sass, and Vue files, and the selectors a stylesheet defines in HTML, Vue, Svelte, and Astro templates.

sass-scss-completion.exclude.markdownDescription: Additional glob patterns excluded from workspace indexing, on top of the built-in list (dependency, build output, and cache directories). Each entry must be a single pattern, for example `vendor-legacy` or `**/generated/**`.

sass-scss-completion.groups.markdownDescription: Pairs the stylesheets that define selectors (`styles`) with the templates those selectors are completed into (`targets`). When the list is empty, every stylesheet in the workspace is offered to every template, and each suggestion shows the folder and file name of its stylesheet.

styles.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for the stylesheets that supply the selectors of this group, for example `assets/theme/**/*.scss` or `public/**/*.css`. SCSS, Sass, and CSS files are read.

targets.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for the template files this group applies to, for example `src/**/*.vue`. An empty list applies the group to every template.

label.markdownDescription: Text shown to the right of each suggestion. Defaults to the folder and file name of the stylesheet that defines the selector.

sass-scss-completion.rules.markdownDescription: Sets the severity of each diagnostic. A rule left out keeps its default: `error` for every check, and `warn` for `no-undefined-custom-property`, since the compiler accepts a custom property name nothing declares. Set a rule to `off` to silence it, to `warn` to report it as a warning, or to `error` to report it as an error. The names match the rules of the `@boomba286/stylelint-plugin-sass-scss` package.

missing-required-arguments.markdownDescription: A call that omits a required argument of a built-in or `@use`d module.

no-undefined-function.markdownDescription: A call to a function or a mixin that nothing defines, including a member a `@use`d module does not export.

no-undefined-variable.markdownDescription: A `$name` use that nothing declares, including a member variable a `@use`d module does not export.

no-undefined-custom-property.markdownDescription: A `var(--name)` use whose name nothing declares in the workspace. Defaults to `warn`.

property-value-no-unknown.markdownDescription: A declaration whose value the property does not accept, for example `display: flexx`.
